However, the field typically includes 5-6 serious contenders: Japan (defending champions, won 2023), USA (won 2017), Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Puerto Rico, and others. Japan has been dominant recently. Given the competitive field of roughly 5-6 top teams, Dominican Republic's probability should be around 12-18%.
